title: Add QEMU rootfs replay gate status panel
purpose: Make boot, rootfs and replay gate evidence visible in the operator console.
scope: Render QEMU boot smoke result and observed markers.
Render rootfs runtime manifest hash and runtime artifact ids.
Render TUI replay, ecosystem replay, functional replay and production runbook smoke statuses.
Show missing or stale gate artifacts as degraded or blocker state.
Keep gate execution in scripts and CI paths.
acceptance_criteria: Gate panel shows AGENTOS_TUI_CONSOLE_READY when observed.
Missing gate artifact is visible and cannot be treated as pass.
Rootfs manifest hash is tied to release provenance.
Panel is read-only projection over gate artifacts.
failure_modes: Missing QEMU smoke is shown as pass.
Gate status ignores TUI console marker.
